content: A teddy bear is a toy. But not every toy is a teddy bear. A ball is a toy too, and a ball is not a teddy bear.
A toy bear stands for a real bear. It is not a real bear. A toy is a small stand-in for something real, made so you can hold it and play with it.
A square is a rectangle, because a square has four corners that are all square corners. But not every rectangle is a square, because a rectangle can be long and thin.
A rectangle is a quadrilateral, because it has four sides. But not every quadrilateral is a rectangle, because the corners need not be square.
